title: Vividly Smoky Japanese Cabbage Okonomiyaki
description: A nostalgic Japanese dish from the Kansai region, featuring roasted cabbage and a smoky flavor, made jain-friendly and served in the form of okonomiyaki, with a glassy-jelly texture and a spicy kick from hotsauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, water, hotsauce, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded cabbage to the bowl and mix until the cabbage is well coated with the batter.
Heat the sesame oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the cabbage mixture into the skillet and shape into a round okonomiyaki.
Cook the okonomiyaki for 4 minutes on the first side, until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the okonomiyaki and cook for an additional 4 minutes, until the other side is also golden brown.
Transfer the okonomiyaki to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the okonomiyaki from the oven and top with chopped green onion.
Serve the okonomiyaki hot and enjoy.
